SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 19, 2023 - 07:00 P.M.
MAIN THEATER - CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Main Theater subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD WEDNESDAY,
APRIL 19, 2023, 7:00 P.M., IN THE MAIN THEATER AT CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE
PERFORMING ARTS, 18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Amaury Rosario, Generations Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Cerritos Seniors Personally Involved in Children’s
  Enrichment (SPICE) Program.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce W. Barrows
  Mayor/Chair Chuong Vo

5.  Mayor’s Welcome and Introductions

  Mayor Vo introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each Councilmember, the Mayor Pro Tem,
  and the Mayor introduced their family and guests in attendance.

6.  Recognition of outgoing Councilmembers and Mayor

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor Chuong Vo. A video was displayed highlighting
  Mayor Vo’s year of service.

7.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  In-Person Public Comments:

  Al Barlevy expressed support for Councilmember Yokoyama to serve as Mayor/Chair.

  Written Correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record. Full-text copies of submitted written
  correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Sue Carter expressed support for Councilmember Johnson to serve as Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

8.  Annual reorganization of the City Council/Successor Agency
  (Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair)

  Vida Barone, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for nominations
  for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Vo nominated Council/Agency Member Barrows for the office of
  Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Barrows as Mayor/Chair by acclamation.

  The office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair was declared vacant by Mayor/Chair Barrows and he
  called for nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Mayor/Chair Barrows nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for the office of Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Johnson nominated Council/Agency Member Yokoyama for the office
  of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

  MOTION: As nominated by Mayor/Chair Barrows, Council/Agency Member Solanki was
  presented for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (3 - 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Vo
  NOES:  Johnson, Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Solanki as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

9.  Closing Comments

  Comments were made by Mayor Barrows, Councilmember Yokoyama, and Mayor Pro Tem
  Solanki.

  Mayor/Chair Barrows invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos Center for the
  Performing Arts in the Sierra Room.

10.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:22 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone
  City Clerk/Agency Secretary
